name: Hulk

abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Physical Vulnerability: Fiziksel Direnci azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen fiziksel hasarı artırır.
abilityDetails.Trauma: Alınan vuruşlar, yakın zamanda verilen hasarın bir kısmını ek fiziksel hasar patlaması olarak verdirir.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Physical Resistance: Fiziksel hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: An enhanced immune system provides full Immunity to Poison.
Gain up to 90% Degeneration Resistance and +[5,328.5] Attack Rating based on missing Health. Maximum benefit at 20% Health.
Stunned Opponents suffer -20% Combat Power Rate, doubled while in GAMMA RAGE.

abilitySections.title: Fury - Max: 20
content: Hulk's Fury Passives grant +[1,065.7] Attack Rating. They last 2 seconds and expire one at a time during GAMMA RAGE, but are paused otherwise.
Their Ability Accuracy cannot be modified, except by Hulk.
When striking the Opponent, 50% to 80% chance to gain a Fury Passive based on missing Health.
When struck, 40% to 70% chance to gain a Fury Passive based on missing Health.
When struck, if Hulk loses more than 10% of his Max Health, gain 5 Fury Passives.

abilitySections.title: GAMMA RAGE
content: Striking an Opponent with a Heavy Attack while Hulk has 5 or more personal Fury Passives inflicts a Stun Debuff for 2 seconds and enters GAMMA RAGE.
When Hulk has 15 or more personal Fury Passives, he automatically enters GAMMA RAGE.
While in GAMMA RAGE, if Hulk would gain a personal Fury Passive, he instead inflicts a [144.74] Physical Vulnerability Debuff for 3 seconds. Max: 20.
While GAMMA RAGE is active, pause all Trauma and Physical Vulnerability Debuffs on the Opponent.
GAMMA RAGE ends when Hulk has no personal Fury Passives, then goes on cooldown for 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: The final hit inflicts a Stun Debuff for 4 seconds. Duration is increased by 100% while in GAMMA RAGE.
Each time this Stun is inflicted, its duration is reduced by 60% until the next time Hulk enters GAMMA RAGE.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The final hit inflicts a Trauma Debuff for each personal Fury Passive currently on Hulk. Trauma lasts for 3 seconds and causes all hits to deal an additional 5% of the damage recently dealt as a burst of Physical Damage. Max: 20.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: If GAMMA RAGE is not active, gain 10 Fury Passives.
If GAMMA RAGE is active, inflict a [11,000] Physical Vulnerability Debuff for 3 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Gamma Brawler
content: When Hulk enters GAMMA RAGE or he strikes the Opponent with a Heavy Attack while it's active, he gains an Unstoppable Passive for [1 - 5.5] seconds.
Gain up to [305.56 - 11,000] Physical Resistance and Critical Resistance while Unstoppable based on missing Health. Potencies for both are reduced by 50% against Skill Champions.
